result.title: When Multiple Choices Are Correct: Asymmetric Probability Allocation in Jev and Other Decision Models
result.summary: Decision models return normalized probability distributions over candidate choices, which downstream applications can use to select among choices. Although their providers emphasize the reliability of these probabilities, calibration on tasks with a single correct choice does not establish their reliability when multiple choices are correct. We evaluate three decision models (Jev, Liquid d1, and GPT-6 Luna Decisions) on three diverse datasets (MetaTool, HotpotQA, and ECtHR) to study probability allocation and thresholding. Even when models rank every correct choice above every distractor, in 28% to 50% of those lists, at least one correct choice receives a probability below the uniform probability of 1/n, where n is the number of choices. We also present each model with five identical copies of a correct choice and observe probability disparities, with mean gaps ranging from 17 to 79 percentage points. We further show how these allocation disparities affect the recovery of multiple correct choices under probability thresholding. Decision-model probabilities can rank correct choices, but a probability threshold does not identify the set of correct choices.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在 MetaTool、HotpotQA、ECtHR 三个数据集上评测 Jev、Liquid d1、GPT-6 Luna Decisions 三个决策模型的概率分配与阈值化行为，发现即使排序完全正确，仍有 28%–50% 的列表存在正确选项概率低于均匀值 1/n 的非对称分配，并显示重复同一正确选项也会产生巨大概率差。
AI.relevance_reason: 「概率阈值无法识别正确选项集合」这一诊断可能为 LVR 中以模型置信度作为 STOP 判据、或多候选 latent 假设的筛选与验证提供反例线索，值得核查其阈值设定与非对称分配的成因是否能迁移到推理期证据选择。
